hook: CTO of 'RansomwareHelp' indicted for wire fraud
hookText: CTO of 'RansomwareHelp' indicted for wire fraud

beats.say: The chief technology officer of a data-recovery firm marketed as RansomwareHelp has been indicted for wire fraud, KrebsOnSecurity reports.
